reviewer: independent raw CSV recomputation; no import or invocation of benchmark aggregation code

method.selection: per-session rows[20:] from each 140-row delivery.csv; no outlier removal
method.pooling: concatenate all four 120-sample measured sessions for each sequence/mode/arm, then sort
method.mean: arithmetic mean of all 480 pooled measured samples

original_audit_boundary.historical_checks: existing audit code explicitly compares pooled mean and P95, not each group P99
original_audit_boundary.this_audit_addition: all 12 tracking P99 values independently recomputed from raw delivery.csv and compared with summary

timing_boundary.delivery: enqueue call start to same-frame receive return; endpoint before caller copy/check
timing_boundary.single: no other frame remains in flight at submission; same-frame receive immediately follows enqueue
timing_boundary.queued: four result slots; delivery includes in-flight waiting and caller receive policy
timing_boundary.separate_from: queued throughput is a separate whole-run wall interval, not reciprocal per-frame delivery latency

interpretation.MOT17_10_single_HR_vs_finetuned: P95 is slightly lower but P99 higher; no blanket tail-latency win
interpretation.queued_HR_vs_finetuned: P95 and P99 higher for both sequences

limitations: 480 measured samples per group are four repeats of one 120-frame post-warmup prefix, not 480 distinct unseen images.
For nearest-rank P99 at N=480, the selected observation is rank 476 and at most four samples are strictly above it; extreme-tail support is small.
Percentiles describe this measured sample pool and are not a long-term tail-latency guarantee or a confidence bound.
P95/P99 are cumulative thresholds, not means of the slowest 5%/1% of samples.
Single and queued are different submission/receive modes; their delivery distributions must remain labeled separately.
No fresh inference, GPU measurement, quality scoring, sanitizer or formal runtime acceptance was performed.

report_plot_table_review.independent_method: parse output SVG XML and recover marker coordinates through displayed 0..8 ms axis; compare with independently pooled raw-CSV percentiles; parse six output TeX rows and both Markdown copies
report_plot_table_review.unit_and_mode_labels: left plot single delivery milliseconds with separate mean/P95/P99 symbols; right plot queued throughput FPS; table labels single and queued P95/P99 in milliseconds
report_plot_table_review.resolved_wording_finding: Replaced inclusive-looking P99以上最多四筆 with strictly-above wording (超過 P99 的樣本最多四筆 / 第476筆之後); percentile itself and ties are not counted as strictly above.
